Record Class BenchmarkSeries.Result

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.BenchmarkSeries.Result
Record Components:
levels - level in main currency per valuation date, null outside the span
instrumentObserved - whether the instrument has a quote dated exactly on that valuation date
rateObserved - whether the rate has a quote dated exactly on that valuation date, always true for an identity conversion
k - index of the first date of the span, -1 without a span
e - index of the last date of the span, -1 without a span
lastInstrumentDate - date of the latest reliable instrument quote up to the last valuation date
lastRateDate - date of the latest reliable rate up to the last valuation date, null for identity
notices - conditions found during the alignment
Enclosing class:
BenchmarkSeries
public static record BenchmarkSeries.Result(Double[] levels, boolean[] instrumentObserved, boolean[] rateObserved, int k, int e, LocalDate lastInstrumentDate, LocalDate lastRateDate, List<BenchmarkNotice> notices) extends Record
Levels and coverage of the benchmark on the valuation dates.
